plugins.name: Shout
plugins.author: Amin
plugins.description: /shout <text> posts the text in uppercase. Optional repeat count in the plugin settings.

plugins.name: VIP Alert
plugins.author: Amin
plugins.description: Toasts when a chosen person writes in any chat. Watch several people at once: comma-separated names or numeric user IDs in the setting below.

plugins.name: Downloader Pro
plugins.author: Amin
plugins.description: Downloads public media into the chat from TikTok, Instagram, X/Twitter, Reddit, Pinterest, Threads and direct media links. Supports albums, quality choices, TikTok MP3, replied-to links, a long-press download action, download history and link fallback.

plugins.name: Temp Mail
plugins.author: Amin
plugins.description: Disposable email via mail.tm: /tm new creates a real account, /tm inbox lists mail, /tm read <id> opens one — verification codes and links are extracted and posted in chat. (v2.1: async HTTP, plugin page with address/copy/inbox/forget actions, address history kept in amin.db.)

plugins.name: Aesthetic Text
plugins.author: Amin
plugins.description: Restyle text: /wide makes ｆｕｌｌｗｉｄｔｈ text, /space spreads l e t t e r s out, /fliptext turns text upside down, /mono makes 𝚖𝚘𝚗𝚘𝚜𝚙𝚊𝚌𝚎 text, /bubble makes ⓑⓤⓑⓑⓛⓔ text, /bold makes 𝐛𝐨𝐥𝐝 text.

plugins.name: Quick Translate
plugins.author: Amin
plugins.description: /tr <text> translates text (default target: Persian). /tr en <text> picks another target language. Long-press a message → Translate does the same for that message.

plugins.name: Gemini Chat
plugins.author: Amin
plugins.description: /ai <question> asks Gemini, using your connected Google account (no API key). Dual mode: AI Studio or Vertex AI (Plugins → Google Account). (v1.1: async requests, plugin page with connection status, question history in amin.db.)

plugins.name: Link Cleaner
plugins.author: Amin
plugins.description: /clean <url> strips tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, igshid, ref, si, …) and resolves short links. No argument reuses the last link seen in this chat — or tap Link Cleaner in the chat attach menu.

plugins.name: QR Maker
plugins.author: Amin
plugins.description: /qr <text or link> posts a QR code image for it (qrserver.com). If the image cannot be sent, the QR image link is posted instead.

plugins.name: Price Check
plugins.author: Amin
plugins.description: /price shows live Iran-market prices in tomans (dollar, gold 18k, Emami coin, BTC, ETH). /price btc|eth|usd|gold|coin shows just one. Sources: tgju.org + CoinGecko — the same endpoints as the toolbox bot.

plugins.name: AI Actions
plugins.author: Amin
plugins.description: AI on any message: reply to a message with /sum to summarize it, /explain to explain it simply, or /draft to draft a reply to it — or pass text directly (/sum <text>). Uses Gemini via your connected Google account (AI Studio or Vertex AI mode, see Plugins → Google Account). (v1.1: async requests, usage stats in amin.db on the plugin page.)

plugins.name: Quick Replies
plugins.author: Amin
plugins.description: Text templates: /tpl set <name> <text> saves one, /tpl <name> posts it, /tpl list shows your templates, /tpl del <name> removes one, /tpl export posts them all in one message. Note: the /tpl command message itself also appears in the chat (the platform can't swallow outgoing commands yet).
